records.description_rewritten: Spektepark is a public recreation area around the Spektesee in Berlin-Spandau. Gay-szene.net's old description asserts night-time cruising near paths by the lake, but its newest dated post (31 July 2026) only asks whether the spot is active, not an actual visit. July 2024 comments give mixed accounts, including two unsuccessful visits. The area is used by ordinary park visitors and exact cruising use remains unverified.

source_and_supplemental_evidence.note: Archived source, 2026 question and older mixed 2024 firsthand posts.

recent_reports.note: Asks if site is still active, not evidence of a visit.

older_posts.note: Someone found men by car park but not a matching encounter.

records.access_information: Public lakeside recreation with ordinary path use; do not infer night-time access, private boundaries, sexual permission, or an actual 2026 crowd.
duplicates_or_flags: Separate Großer Spektesee lake, Spektepark paths and car park subarea.

Another archive on Planet Randy lists the Steglitz park generally, which does not prove the exact same woodland section is active.

records.description_rewritten: The source's title Strandbad Müggelsee is misleading for its cruising claims. A 2 July 2025 long-time visitor expressly says the meeting area is outside the managed bath and outside its FKK section, around the Norduferstrand; other June 2025 accounts refer to the FKK area and toilets, so the claims conflict. None establishes activity in the last 12 months. Berlin district authority confirms major 2026 bathing facility renovation: from 7 September WC containers removed, and after 31 October only facilities by the FKK section were expected until spring 2027. This is physical access information, not gay-cruising verification.

source_and_supplemental_evidence.note: 2025 conflicting eyewitness descriptions and correction to northern shore.
25 Aug 2026 official WC closure, temporary facilities removed 31 Oct; renovation works.
Secondary gay travel directory broadly mentions Müggelsee.

records.access_information: Family swimming facility and FKK section with separated public paths; current reconstruction, site fences and temporary toilet changes. No access through restricted works or assumption that naturism authorises sex.

records.description_rewritten: An older underground men's public toilet at Theodor-Heuss-Platz in Westend is the subject of two gay directories. May 2026 visitors describe encounters but one dated 17 May firsthand report alleges aggressive homophobic verbal abuse and a door kick while another man was present. July 2026 forum includes both a successful self-report and several separate unsuccessful visitors. This supports mixed recent real-world use and an important harassment warning, not a guarantee of crowds or fixed hours. Older posts refer to periodic closures and strong odours.

source_and_supplemental_evidence.note: Detailed July and May 2026 visitor reports, including alleged harassment.

records.description_rewritten: Treptower Park is a large riverside recreation park. The gay-szene.net index identifies a particular FKK meadow near the Archenhold Observatory; Planet Randy also lists the park. The last user posts found are from July–August 2024 describing sunbathing and a few men present, with no 2026 firsthand cruising visits confirmed. Older discussions about vegetation height and whether the meadow is maintained make historical privacy assumptions unreliable.

source_and_supplemental_evidence.note: Gay directory 2024 visitor reports, with old privacy/harassment context.
Second gay directory lists Treptower Park.
